description: Learning Enhancement Suite - Structured notes, smart bookmarks, flashcard review with SM-2, and knowledge graph visualization

userStories.title: Add slide_note and document_summary tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need per-slide note storage to replace the single-blob notebook model.
acceptanceCriteria: Add slide_note table: id, document_id (FK), slide_id (FK), page_num, content_md, source (manual/ai/mixed), created_at, updated_at
Add document_summary table: id, document_id (FK, UNIQUE), content_md, created_at, updated_at
Tables created in init_db() using existing SQLModel pattern
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Migrate existing documentnotebook data to slide_note
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to split existing notebook content by '## Page X' headings into per-slide notes.
acceptanceCriteria: On startup, detect documentnotebook rows not yet migrated
Split content_md by '## Page' or '## Slide' headings into individual slide_note rows
Unmatched content goes to document_summary
Migration is idempotent (safe to run multiple times)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add slide-notes CRUD API endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need REST endpoints to read and write per-slide notes.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/slide-notes/{document_id} returns all slide notes for a document
GET /api/v1/slide-notes/slide/{slide_id} returns single slide note
PUT /api/v1/slide-notes/slide/{slide_id} creates or updates a slide note
Response includes slide_id, page_num, content_md, source, updated_at
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add slide_bookmark table and API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need bookmark storage with tag-based filtering.
acceptanceCriteria: Add slide_bookmark table: id, document_id (FK), slide_id (FK), page_num, tag (important/difficult/review/exam), note (optional text), created_at
Unique constraint on (slide_id, tag) to prevent duplicate tags per slide
POST /api/v1/bookmarks creates bookmark {slide_id, tag, note?}
DELETE /api/v1/bookmarks/{bookmark_id} removes bookmark
GET /api/v1/bookmarks/{document_id} returns all bookmarks, supports ?tag= filter
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add flashcard table
userStories.description: As a developer, I need flashcard storage linked to slides.
acceptanceCriteria: Add flashcard table: id, document_id (FK), slide_id (FK), front_md (question), back_md (answer), source (auto/manual), created_at
Table created in init_db()
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add flashcard CRUD API endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need endpoints to manage flashcards.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/flashcards/{document_id} returns all flashcards for a document
POST /api/v1/flashcards creates a manual flashcard {slide_id, front_md, back_md}
DELETE /api/v1/flashcards/{flashcard_id} removes a flashcard
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add concept and concept_relation tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tables to store extracted concepts and their relationships for the knowledge graph.
acceptanceCriteria: Add concept table: id, document_id (FK), name, description, slide_ids (JSON array), created_at
Add concept_relation table: id, document_id (FK), source_id (FK->concept), target_id (FK->concept), relation_type (prerequisite/related/part_of/contrast), created_at
Tables created in init_db()
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: AI generate slide note from explanation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to generate a structured note from an existing slide explanation.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/slide-notes/slide/{slide_id}/generate calls model_gateway
Prompt transforms slideexplanation.markdown into concise note format: key points + terms + summary
Result saved to slide_note with source='ai'
Returns 404 if no explanation exists for the slide
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Batch generate notes for all slides in a document
userStories.description: As a user, I want to generate notes for all slides that don't have notes yet.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/slide-notes/{document_id}/generate-all generates notes for slides missing slide_note
Skips slides without explanations
Returns count of generated notes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: AI generate flashcards from slide explanation
userStories.description: As a user, I want AI to create Q&A flashcards from a slide's explanation.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/flashcards/slide/{slide_id}/generate calls model_gateway
Generates 3-5 flashcards per slide: definition, comparison, and fill-in-the-blank types
Each flashcard saved with source='auto'
Creates corresponding reviewitem entries with source_ref='flashcard:{id}'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Batch generate flashcards for entire document
userStories.description: As a user, I want to generate flashcards for all slides at once.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/flashcards/{document_id}/generate-all generates flashcards for all slides with explanations
Skips slides that already have auto-generated flashcards
Returns total flashcard count
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: AI extract concepts for knowledge graph
userStories.description: As a user, I want AI to extract key concepts and relationships from my document.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/knowledge-graph/{document_id}/generate reads all slideexplanation rows
LLM prompt returns structured JSON: {concepts: [{name, description, slide_nums}], relations: [{source, target, type}]}
Results saved to concept and concept_relation tables
Replaces previous concepts for the document (delete + insert)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Knowledge graph read API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an endpoint to return graph data for frontend rendering.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/knowledge-graph/{document_id} returns {nodes: Concept[], edges: ConceptRelation[]}
Nodes include id, name, description, slide_ids
Edges include source_id, target_id, relation_type
Returns empty graph if not generated yet
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Flashcard stats API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an endpoint for per-document flashcard mastery statistics.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/flashcards/{document_id}/stats returns per-slide stats
Each slide entry: {slide_id, page_num, total, mastered (easiness>2.5 and interval>7), due_count}
Includes document-level summary: {total, mastered, due, mastery_percent}
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Export notes as Obsidian-compatible Markdown
userStories.description: As an Obsidian user, I want to export structured notes with wiki-links and tags.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/slide-notes/{document_id}/export returns Markdown string

Format: '# DocName
## Page 1: Title
content
---
## Page 2: ...'
Bookmark tags embedded as Obsidian tags: #important #difficult #review #exam
Key terms wrapped in [[term]] wiki-link format
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Notebook panel UI - page navigation sidebar
userStories.description: As a user, I want the notebook panel to show a page list so I know which pages have notes.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace single textarea with split layout: left page-nav (narrow) + right editor
Page nav shows page numbers with dot indicator (filled=has note, empty=no note)
Each page row shows first 30 chars of note as preview
Clicking a page loads that slide's note into the editor
Switching slides auto-selects the corresponding page in nav
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Notebook panel - AI generate and full-doc view buttons
userStories.description: As a user, I want buttons to generate notes from AI and view all notes as one document.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'From AI' button in editor toolbar that calls generate endpoint for current slide
Add 'Generate All' button that calls batch generate endpoint
Add 'Full Doc' tab that concatenates all slide notes into read-only preview
Loading states shown during AI generation

userStories.title: Bookmark buttons on slide viewer
userStories.description: As a user, I want to tag slides as important/difficult/review/exam from the slide viewer.
acceptanceCriteria: 4 icon buttons in slide viewer top-right: star (important), brain (difficult), refresh (review), pencil (exam)
Clicking toggles the bookmark on/off via POST/DELETE API
Active bookmarks are highlighted with color: red/orange/blue/purple

userStories.title: Bookmark filter bar on thumbnail list
userStories.description: As a user, I want to filter the slide list to show only bookmarked slides.

Selecting a filter hides non-matching slides

Filter resets to 'All' when switching documents

userStories.title: Flashcard review entry point and today's count
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see how many flashcards are due and enter review mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Add review icon button in header bar showing badge with due count
Badge shows number of reviewitems where due_at <= now and status='pending' and source_ref starts with 'flashcard:'

userStories.title: Flashcard review interface

userStories.title: Mastery progress indicators on thumbnails
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see flashcard mastery progress on each slide thumbnail.
acceptanceCriteria: Each thumbnail with flashcards shows a thin progress bar at bottom
Colors: green=mastered, yellow=learning, gray=not started
Document list page shows overall mastery percentage badge
Progress updates after review completion

Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Knowledge graph visualization panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see an interactive concept map of my document.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Graph' tab in the AI panel area
Install and use react-force-graph-2d for rendering
Nodes sized by number of linked slides (more slides = larger)
Edges colored by relation type (prerequisite=red, related=blue, part_of=green, contrast=orange)

userStories.title: Knowledge graph node interaction
userStories.description: As a user, I want to hover/click nodes to see details and jump to slides.
acceptanceCriteria: Hover shows tooltip: concept name, description, 'Pages: 3, 7, 12'
Click on node with single slide jumps to that slide
Click on node with multiple slides shows page list popup, clicking a page jumps there
